dds_andor_10.m: Hello, $playername, is it really you? You have grown.

dds_andor_20.m: Why? Did you miss me so much? Or do you not want to have to do Mikhail's work all by yourself?
r: Don't talk nonsense. I'm glad to see you. Come home with me.

dds_andor_30.m: I can't. At least not yet.
r: But why? Does someone want to do something bad to you? I won't allow that.

dds_andor_40.m: [Andor laughs dryly] Let it go, it's the big brother's job to keep an eye on things.

dds_andor_50.m: No. It's not possible. You'll understand that one day.
r: Are you just going to disappear again? Please don't!
Are you just going to disappear again? Please don't!

dds_andor_62.m: Don't worry - we'll see each other again, in happier days.

darkness_in_daylight.10: I met Miri in the Crossroads Guardhouse.
darkness_in_daylight.20: Since I had helped Ailshara, she wouldn't tell me about Andor.
darkness_in_daylight.30: Since I had hidden the truth about the bootlegging of beer from Sullengard, she wouldn't tell me about Andor.
darkness_in_daylight.40: Since I had aided Feygard once or twice earlier, she would tell me about Andor, after I had completed an investigation for her.
darkness_in_daylight.50: Since Miri was poisoned by slitherers near Sullengard, and healing is taking time, she wanted me to investigate something bad in the Purple Hills in the strange areas to the south of Stoutford.
darkness_in_daylight.60: I went to the area to the south of Stoutford and encountered an impassable force there.
darkness_in_daylight.70: There was a piece of Kazaul ritual there, which I had encountered before. I should inform Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.80: Miri asked me where I had seen this before. I told her about a task I had carried out on behalf of Throdna of the Blackwater settlement.
darkness_in_daylight.90: Miri told me to meet him and enquire further. And gave me a phrase to use whenever he started rambling.
darkness_in_daylight.100: Throdna told me it was part of a ritual to break the barrier which forms when one does a ritual to call strong Kazaul monsters.
darkness_in_daylight.110: The ritual consisted of two parts which I had found earlier, and a chant in a book called Calomyran Secrets. I need to report this to Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.120: I told Miri about finding the book for an Old Man in Fallhaven.  She told me to talk to him.
darkness_in_daylight.130: The Old Man would not let me borrow the book, so I started noting the chant in front of him.
darkness_in_daylight.140: The book contained half the chant. The rest was to be found in another book Azimyran Secrets.
darkness_in_daylight.150: Miri told me she'd trace the book. She told me to wait for her return.
darkness_in_daylight.160: Miri came back and told me that the book Azimyran Secrets was with an old hermit near Arulir mountain.
darkness_in_daylight.170: I met the old hermit and asked him about the book, Azimyran Secrets.
darkness_in_daylight.180: He refused to give it to me, so I copied the chant sitting with him. I needed to tell Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.190: Miri told me to hurry, and pass the barrier.
darkness_in_daylight.198: After destroying the ritual statue of Kazaul, beyond the barrier I found a crying woman.
darkness_in_daylight.200: She was performing a ritual that should bring her husband back to life.
darkness_in_daylight.210: Miri, who followed me, convinced the woman that it was actually an evil ritual to overrun Dhayavar with Kazaul's monsters.
darkness_in_daylight.220: The mourning woman told us that the ritual was given to her by a priest who walks on lava east of the Purple Hills.
darkness_in_daylight.230: We let the mourning woman go.
darkness_in_daylight.232: The mourning woman cried that she would never be happy again.
darkness_in_daylight.240: I had to travel to the lava wastelands.
darkness_in_daylight.250: There, after fighting monsters, I met a priest in red.
darkness_in_daylight.260: He accused me of interfering. Miri, who again followed me, revealed the red priest to be a monster.
darkness_in_daylight.280: Miri fulfilled her promise and told me that Andor would be refilling his food supplies at Rosmara's food stand.
darkness_in_daylight.300: Indeed, I have found Andor there.
darkness_in_daylight.310: He told me he couldn't come home now, and vanished.

shadows.10: I met Borvis on the great road near Alynndir's hut.
shadows.20: Since I had told Gandoren about the switch of the weapons, and also the truth about the bootlegging of beer from Sullengard, he told me to leave.
shadows.30: Since I aided the Shadow once or twice earlier, he requested my further help for an urgent task.
shadows.40: He wanted me to investigate something bad in the Purple Hills in the weird areas to the south of Stoutford.
shadows.50: I went to the area to the south of Stoutford, and encountered an impassable force there.
shadows.60: There were strange glowing, immovable pebbles there. I had to inform Borvis.
shadows.70: Borvis told me that was the basic, but effective, Shadow shield, to protect Shadow incantations from outside interference.
shadows.80: For that, he would give me a chant. But I had to get him energies in the form of four 'blessings' - Shadow's Strength, Shadow Awareness, Fatigue, and Life Drain - within myself. He told me to go to Talion in Loneford for the first blessing, and for information about the others.
shadows.90: Talion bestowed me with Shadow's Strength.
shadows.100: Talion told me to seek out Jolnor in Vilegard for the rest of the 'blessings'.
shadows.110: Jolnor bestowed me with Shadow Awareness.
shadows.120: Jolnor told me to seek Favlon to the west of Sullengard for the remaining two.
shadows.130: I reached Favlon who asked me for 10 Cooked Meat.
shadows.140: I gave Favlon 10 Cooked Meat. He bestowed me with 'blessings' of Fatigue and Life Drain.
shadows.150: After a grueling travel back, I returned to Borvis.
shadows.160: Borvis removed the 'blessings' from me, and made a chant.
shadows.165: Borvis told me to hurry back to the barrier.
shadows.178: After destroying the ritual statue of Kazaul, beyond the barrier I found a crying woman.
shadows.180: She was performing a ritual that should bring her husband back to life.
shadows.190: Borvis, who followed me, convinced the woman that it was actually an evil ritual to overrun Dhayar with Kazaul's monsters.
shadows.200: The mourning woman told us that the ritual was given to her by a priest in the lava wastelands.
shadows.210: We let the mourning woman go.
shadows.212: The mourning woman cried that she would never be happy again.
shadows.220: I had to travel to the lava wastelands.
shadows.230: There, after fighting monsters, I met a priest in red.
shadows.240: He accused me of interfering again and again. Borvis, who again followed me, revealed the red priest to be a monster.
shadows.260: Borvis fulfilled his promise and told me that Andor would be refilling his supplies from Alynndir.
shadows.290: He told me he couldn't come home now, and vanished.

andor.1: My father Mikhail says that Andor has not been home since yesterday. I should go look for him in the village.
andor.10: Leonid tells me that he saw Andor talking to Gruil. I should go ask Gruil if he knows more.
andor.20: Gruil wants me to bring him a poison gland. Then he might talk more. He tells me that some poisonous snakes have such a gland.
andor.30: Gruil tells me that Andor was looking for someone called Umar. I should go ask his friend Gaela in Fallhaven to the east.
andor.40: I talked to Gaela in Fallhaven. He tells me to go see Bucus and ask about the Thieves' Guild.
andor.50: Bucus has allowed me to enter the hatch in the derelict house in Fallhaven. I should go talk to Umar.
andor.51: Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild recognized me, but must have me confused with Andor. Apparently, Andor has been to see him.
andor.55: Umar told me that Andor went to see a potion maker called Lodar. I should search for his hideaway.
andor.61: I heard a story in Loneford, where it seemed like Andor had been in Loneford, and that he might have had something to do with the illness that the people are suffering from there. I am not sure if it actually was Andor. If it was Andor, why would he have made the people of Loneford ill?
andor.62: Andor might have gone to do some business with a rich man in Brimhaven after he left Loneford.
andor.65: It looks like Andor was involved in the destruction of the Brimhaven dam.
andor.70: I have found the potion-maker Lodar, and heard his story about Andor. Andor went to visit Lodar in his hideaway to get a sample of something called Narwood extract. Lodar happened to notice that there was someone travelling together with Andor, that hid among the trees and did not seem to want Lodar to spot him.
andor.71: Shortly after Andor and the person he was travelling with had left, strange things started to happen in the woods around Lodar's hideaway, and Lodar himself seemed to be affected by it somehow. Lodar believes that something disturbed the tomb below his cabin, and awoke the Hira'zinn.
andor.72: Since I helped Lodar defeat the Hira'zinn, he promised to help me in return. He gave me a piece of paper that should allow me to enter the Valanyr temple of the Shadow in Nor City. He told me to seek out lady Lydalon in the temple for further assistance.
andor.80: All clues so far as to where Andor went point to Nor City. I should travel to Nor City by following the Duleian road to the southeast and look for more clues there.
andor.85: Andor may have been in Stoutford.
andor.86: Andor had something to do with the demon under the church in Stoutford.
andor.90: At Castle Guynmart I learned from Steward Unkorh that some time ago Andor was also there as a guest.
andor.92: Unkorh gave me the bonemeal potion box that Andor had given him for safekeeping.
andor.100: While exploring the town of Sullengard, I so happened to stumble upon my mother and my aunt to whom I have never met. Mother has insisted that I go home so we can talk.
andor.110: After talking with mother back at home, she and I tried to brainstorm about where Andor could be. She reminded me about Andor's friend Stanwick who lives in Brightport. We agreed that going to talk to him might be the next logical thing to do.
andor.120: In the dungeons of Laeroth manor, Kotheses, the torturer, mentioned that he had taught Andor the basics of torturing.
andor.125: Vaelric confirmed that Andor visited him recently. Andor sought to learn Vaelric's skills and left quickly, clutching what he came for. His actions raise more questions about his intentions.
andor.126: In Brightport, I was finally able to meet Stanwick, but due to his hazy memory, he was not able to help me learn anything about the whereabouts of Andor.
andor.127: Regaining his peace of mind after I helped him, Stanwick said he'll tell me more about Andor, once he gathers his thoughts.
andor.128: Stanwick gave me a signet ring that I should show to his father. Jorwick, in Nor City.
andor.130: Andor was trying to find out from Seraphina about terrible monsters in the hideout near the place with the larval burrowers.
andor.131: Elysa in the Brightport's thieves guild told me that Andor has bought a map to the sewers of Feygard.
andor.132: While investigating the Brightport theft I learned from Bryma that Andor was the one who stole the important document, and brought it to her in exchange for her alchemy knowledge.
andor.140: I saw Andor in the mountains of Galmore. We were able to exchange a few words before he disappeared again.
andor.145: I met Andor on the road to Feygard, where he was buying food from Rosmara. He disappeared again.
andor.147: I met Andor on the road to Nor City, where he was buying supplies from Alynndir. He disappeared again.
andor.910: I decided to settle down on the top of Mt. Galmore. For this I needed to find a rich and discreet man to rebuild the ruins according to my wishes. Andor will now have to go and find himself.
andor.912: The construction contract for my new home was completed. I was curious to see what it would look like.
andor.914: I visited my new residence on the top of Mt. Galmore. There I would help the people of Dhayavar as a hero and protect them from villains. Or would I become a villain myself? We'll see.
andor.999: [Quest is not completable at this time.]

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
